      $('#resetSettings').addEventListener('click', () => { setDensity('balanced'); applyTheme('light'); $('#motionToggle').checked = true; $('#hintToggle').checked = true; $('#liveToggle').checked = true; document.body.classList.remove('motion-off', 'hints-off'); $$('.topology .edge').forEach((edge) => edge.style.animationPlayState = 'running'); toast('視圖設定已重設'); });

      let seconds = 8;
      setInterval(() => { seconds = (seconds + 1) % 60; const now = new Date(); now.setSeconds(seconds); if ($('#liveToggle').checked) $('#syncText').textContent = '即時同步中 · ' + now.toLocaleTimeString('zh-TW', { hour12: false }); }, 1000);
    })();
  </script>
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';
  const KEY = 'via.sync.state.v2';
  const LEGACY_KEY = 'via.sync.state.v1';
  const CHANNEL = 'via.sync.v2';
  const $ = (selector, root = document) => root.querySelector(selector);
  const $$ = (selector, root = document) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(selector));
  const canStore = (() => { try { const key = '__via_storage_test__'; localStorage.setItem(key, '1'); localStorage.removeItem(key); return true; } catch (error) { return false; } })();
  const channel = typeof BroadcastChannel === 'function' ? new BroadcastChannel(CHANNEL) : null;
  const typeNames = { dashboard: '儀表板', data: '資料端點', automation: '自動化', governance: '治理稽核', integration: '外部整合' };
  const defaultModules = [
    { id: 'overview', name: '系統總覽', type: 'dashboard', enabled: true, pinned: true, order: 1, system: true },
    { id: 'topology', name: '銜接拓撲', type: 'integration', enabled: true, pinned: true, order: 2, system: true },
    { id: 'endpoints', name: '資料端點', type: 'data', enabled: true, pinned: false, order: 3, system: true },
    { id: 'events', name: '即時事件流', type: 'automation', enabled: true, pinned: false, order: 4, system: true },
    { id: 'governance', name: '權限治理', type: 'governance', enabled: true, pinned: false, order: 5, system: true }
  ];
  const clone = (value) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
  const timeLabel = (iso) => { try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('zh-TW', { hour12: false }); } catch (error) { return '剛剛'; } };
  const slugify = (value) => String(value || 'module').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9\u4e00-\u9fff]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 48) || 'module';
  const normalizeModules = (input) => {
    const list = Array.isArray(input) && input.length ? input : clone(defaultModules);
    return list.map((raw, index) => ({
      id: slugify(raw.id || raw.name || `module-${index + 1}`), name: String(raw.name || raw.id || `模組 ${index + 1}`),
      type: typeNames[raw.type] ? raw.type : 'dashboard', enabled: raw.enabled !== false, pinned: raw.pinned === true,
      order: Number(raw.order) || index + 1, system: raw.system === true
    })).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
  };
  const DEFAULT_LAYOUT = { fontScale: 0.94, headerHeight: 44, panelHeight: 292, equalPanels: true, surface: 'light' };
  const normalizeLayout = (input) => { const value = input && typeof input === 'object' ? input : {}; return { fontScale: Math.max(0.88, Math.min(1, Number(value.fontScale) || 0.94)), headerHeight: Math.max(36, Math.min(72, Number(value.headerHeight) || 44)), panelHeight: Math.max(220, Math.min(560, Number(value.panelHeight) || 292)), equalPanels: value.equalPanels !== false, surface: ['light', 'soft'].includes(value.surface) ? value.surface : 'light' }; };
  const legacyToV2 = (raw) => ({ version: 2, updatedAt: raw.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString(), source: raw.source || 'legacy-v1', view: {
    density: raw.density === '1.15' ? 'comfortable' : raw.density === '.86' ? 'compact' : 'balanced', theme: raw.theme || 'light', motion: raw.motion !== false, hints: raw.hints !== false, live: raw.live !== false, autoApply: raw.autoApply !== false, paused: raw.paused === true, activeTab: raw.activeTab || '即時流量', activeNav: raw.activeNav || '總覽'
  }, modules: clone(defaultModules), layout: clone(DEFAULT_LAYOUT), sync: { scope: 'all', conflict: 'latest', debounceMs: 250, revision: 0 } });
  const normalize = (raw) => {
    const source = raw && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
    if (Number(source.version) < 2 || !source.view) return legacyToV2(source);
    const view = source.view || {}, sync = source.sync || {};
    return { version: 2, updatedAt: source.updatedAt || new Date().toISOString(), source: source.source || 'UI', view: {
      density: ['comfortable', 'balanced', 'compact'].includes(view.density) ? view.density : 'balanced', theme: ['light', 'highContrast', 'system'].includes(view.theme) ? view.theme : 'light', motion: view.motion !== false, hints: view.hints !== false, live: view.live !== false, autoApply: view.autoApply !== false, paused: view.paused === true, activeTab: view.activeTab || '即時流量', activeNav: view.activeNav || '總覽'
    }, modules: normalizeModules(source.modules), analytics: source.analytics && typeof source.analytics === 'object' ? source.analytics : { templateId: 'blank', templateName: '一般空白', charts: [], history: [], pivot: { rowField: 'date', columnField: 'metric', valueField: 'value', aggregation: 'sum' } }, layout: normalizeLayout(source.layout), sync: {
      scope: ['all', 'view-only', 'modules-only', 'manual'].includes(sync.scope) ? sync.scope : 'all', conflict: ['latest', 'local', 'remote'].includes(sync.conflict) ? sync.conflict : 'latest', debounceMs: Math.max(0, Math.min(5000, Number(sync.debounceMs) || 250)), revision: Number(sync.revision) || 0
    } };
  };
  const read = () => { if (!canStore) return null; try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || localStorage.getItem(LEGACY_KEY) || 'null'); } catch (error) { return null; } };
  let activeState = normalize(read() || {}), applying = false, originId = `ui-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`;
  const write = (state, broadcast = true) => {
    if (canStore) { try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch (error) {} }
    if (broadcast && channel && state.sync.scope !== 'manual') channel.postMessage({ type: 'via-state-v2', originId, state: clone(state) });
    if ($('#syncText')) $('#syncText').textContent = '本機同步 · ' + timeLabel(state.updatedAt);
    if ($('#footerSync')) $('#footerSync').textContent = timeLabel(state.updatedAt);
  };
  const renderCustomModules = () => {
    const primary = $('.sidebar .nav');
    if (!primary) return;
    let label = $('#customModuleLabel'), nav = $('#customModuleNav');
    if (!label) { label = document.createElement('div'); label.id = 'customModuleLabel'; label.className = 'nav-label custom-module-label'; label.textContent = '自定義模組'; primary.after(label); }
    if (!nav) { nav = document.createElement('nav'); nav.id = 'customModuleNav'; nav.className = 'nav custom-module-nav'; nav.setAttribute('aria-label', '自定義管理模組'); label.after(nav); }
    nav.replaceChildren();
    const modules = activeState.modules.filter((module) => module.enabled && !module.system);
    label.hidden = modules.length === 0; nav.hidden = modules.length === 0;
    modules.forEach((module) => {
      const button = document.createElement('button'); button.className = 'nav-item'; button.type = 'button'; button.dataset.nav = module.id; button.title = module.note || typeNames[module.type] || '自定義模組';
      button.innerHTML = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M8 12h8M12 8v8"/></svg>';
      const text = document.createElement('span'); text.className = 'nav-text'; text.textContent = module.name; button.append(text);
      button.addEventListener('click', () => { $$('.nav-item').forEach((item) => item.classList.remove('active')); button.classList.add('active'); activeState.view.activeNav = module.id; publish('UI'); toast('已切換至自定義模組「' + module.name + '」'); });
      nav.append(button);
    });
    $$('.nav-item').forEach((item) => item.classList.toggle('active', item.dataset.nav === activeState.view.activeNav));
  };
  const apply = (incoming, notify = false) => {
    if (!incoming) return;
    const state = normalize(incoming);
    applying = true;
    if (state.sync.scope !== 'modules-only') { document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui-font-scale', String(state.layout.fontScale)); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--header-h', state.layout.headerHeight + 'px'); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui-panel-h', state.layout.panelHeight + 'px'); document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--ui-surface', state.layout.surface === 'soft' ? '#f4f8f5' : '#fbfcfb'); document.body.dataset.equalPanels = String(state.layout.equalPanels); }
    const scope = state.sync.scope;
    if (scope !== 'modules-only') {
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--density', ({ comfortable: '1.15', balanced: '1', compact: '.86' }[state.view.density] || '1'));
      $$('#densityControl button').forEach((button) => button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset.density === state.view.density));
      document.body.dataset.theme = state.view.theme;
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--line', state.view.theme === 'highContrast' ? '#b7c8bf' : '#dce5e0');
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--muted', state.view.theme === 'highContrast' ? '#5f7169' : '#778680');
      $$('#themeControl button').forEach((button) => button.classList.toggle('active', button.dataset.theme === state.view.theme));
      $('#motionToggle').checked = state.view.motion; $('#hintToggle').checked = state.view.hints; $('#liveToggle').checked = state.view.live; $('#autoApply').checked = state.view.autoApply;
      document.body.classList.toggle('motion-off', !state.view.motion); document.body.classList.toggle('hints-off', !state.view.hints);
      $$('.topology .edge').forEach((edge) => edge.style.animationPlayState = state.view.motion ? 'running' : 'paused');
      $('#pauseFlowBtn').dataset.paused = String(state.view.paused); $('#pauseFlowBtn').querySelector('span').textContent = state.view.paused ? '恢復流量' : '暫停流量';
      $$('.tab').forEach((tab) => tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.tab === state.view.activeTab));
    }
    if (scope !== 'view-only') activeState.modules = state.modules;
    activeState.view = scope === 'modules-only' ? activeState.view : state.view;
    activeState.sync = state.sync; activeState.updatedAt = state.updatedAt; activeState.source = state.source; activeState.version = 2;
    renderCustomModules(); applying = false; write(activeState, false);
    if (notify) toast('已套用本機同步狀態');
  };
  const current = () => normalize({ ...activeState, version: 2, source: 'UI', updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), view: { ...activeState.view, density: ({ '1.15': 'comfortable', '1': 'balanced', '.86': 'compact' }[getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--density').trim()] || 'balanced'), theme: document.body.dataset.theme || 'light', motion: $('#motionToggle').checked, hints: $('#hintToggle').checked, live: $('#liveToggle').checked, autoApply: $('#autoApply').checked, paused: $('#pauseFlowBtn').dataset.paused === 'true', activeTab: $('.tab.active')?.dataset.tab || activeState.view.activeTab, activeNav: $('.nav-item.active')?.dataset.nav || activeState.view.activeNav } });
  const publish = (source = 'UI') => { if (applying || activeState.sync.scope === 'manual') return; activeState = current(); activeState.source = source; activeState.sync.revision += 1; write(activeState, true); };
  window.__viaToast = window.__viaToast || ((message) => toast(message));
  $$('#densityControl button, #themeControl button, #motionToggle, #hintToggle, #liveToggle, #autoApply, #pauseFlowBtn, .tab, .nav-item').forEach((element) => element.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(() => publish('UI'), 0)));
  $$('#motionToggle, #hintToggle, #liveToggle, #autoApply').forEach((element) => element.addEventListener('change', () => setTimeout(() => publish('UI'), 0)));
  if (channel) channel.onmessage = (event) => { if (event.data?.originId !== originId && event.data?.type === 'via-state-v2') apply(event.data.state, true); if (event.data?.type === 'via-clear-v2') apply(normalize({}), true); };
  window.addEventListener('storage', (event) => { if (event.key === KEY && event.newValue) { try { apply(JSON.parse(event.newValue), true); } catch (error) {} } });
  apply(activeState, false);
})();
</script>

<script>
(()=>{const btn=document.getElementById('uiLabBtn'),lab=document.getElementById('uiLab');if(!btn||!lab)return;btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{lab.hidden=!lab.hidden;btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!lab.hidden));if(typeof window.toast==='function')window.toast(lab.hidden?'元件檢視已收合':'已開啟本機 UI 元件沙盒');});})();
</script>
